text: ANDREY: clicking a section inside the plan does nothing — should navigate to the task(s) covering it. When close on the plan, show go-to-task / go-to-spec affordances (buttons). Camera moves only on this user click (§31-compliant: user-initiated).

§32.7 done — section rows interactive: single-click highlights connected task edges+nodes via highlight state (NO camera move, §31), double-click/Crosshair frames them (fly+blink); copy-id + go-to + open-pane + focus-stride affordances at W2/W3; wired SectionNode->nodeRegistry->CanvasView (onSectionClick/onSectionFrame)
